# Vermilion Routes
> Luxury Boutique Travel Agency & Expert-Guided Expeditions across mainland Ecuador and the Galápagos Islands.

Vermilion Routes provides bespoke luxury expeditions, Galápagos island hopping, private cruises, Amazon rainforest lodges, and Avenue of the Volcanoes treks.

## Core Destinations & Expeditions
- [Galapagos Islands](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#galapagos): Island hopping, yacht excursions, Santa Cruz, Isabela, San Cristóbal, Bartolomé, Las Grietas, giant tortoises, marine wildlife.
- [Avenue of the Volcanoes](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#ecuador): Cotopaxi National Park, Quilotoa Crater Lagoon, Chimborazo Summit Reserve, Baños Pailón del Diablo Waterfall.
- [Amazon Rainforest](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#ecuador): Cuyabeno Wildlife Reserve, Yasuní National Park, Napo River motorized canoe expeditions, indigenous Kichwa communities.
- [Colonial Heritage & Markets](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#ecuador): Quito Historic Center (UNESCO), Cuenca Colonial, Otavalo Indigenous Market, Ingapirca Inca Ruins.

## Featured Itineraries
- [Galápagos Islands 4-Day Itinerary](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#tours): Santa Cruz highlands, Primicias giant tortoise ranch, Isabela full-day excursion, Tintoreras snorkeling.
- [Galápagos Islands 5-Day Itinerary](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#tours): Comprehensive island hopping, Charles Darwin Research Station, Santa Fe / Bartolomé.
- [Ecuador: Andes & Amazon Rainforest (7 Days / 6 Nights)](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#tours): Historic Quito, Cotopaxi, Quilotoa, Baños waterfalls, Amazon jungle lodge.
- [Ecuador & Galápagos Islands Master Journey (12 Days / 11 Nights)](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/es#tours): Complete luxury overland expedition and Galápagos archipelago discovery.
